question: How does abstaining from food by day lead beyond death by aging?
premises: Non-eating by day is the means
Death by aging is the object
A future overcoming of that death is stated
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond death by aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean go to or go beyond death; context suggests overcoming
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death by aging.
